memory_update.text: For specialized AI cloud capacity, CRWV and NBIS should be treated as reference leaders rather than underfollowed alpha candidates because public attention and large customer announcements are already high.

IREN remains relevant to the underfollowed lane because the market may still classify it through a bitcoin-mining lens, but the AI-cloud thesis requires verification of contracted revenue, financing terms, power economics, and utilization.

APLD is a second-order AI capacity candidate focused on powered data-center campuses and leasing rather than pure GPU-cloud software; it should be evaluated on power, construction execution, lease terms, counterparty quality, and balance-sheet survivability.

The key chokepoint variables for this node are not GPU ownership alone; survival through Layer 2 requires evidence of connected power, customer contracts, financing durability, deployment speed, depreciation assumptions, and realized utilization.

The current U.S.-listed universe of pure-play AI-cloud capacity names is small and increasingly well followed; further underfollowed discovery may need to move one step sideways into data-center developers, power equipment, liquid cooling, interconnect, leasing finance, and AI infrastructure software orchestration.
Use CoreWeave as the reference neocloud benchmark for specialized AI cloud capacity, but avoid letting it crowd out upstream powered-capacity suppliers.

Applied Digital, Core Scientific, and TeraWulf are better fits for this Layer 1B search focus than general hyperscalers because they map to power-connected AI data-center capacity and colocation constraints.

The most investable chokepoint signal in this node is not GPU ownership alone; it is the combination of secured power, high-density data-center readiness, credible customers, and financing survivability.

Need a later pass focused on balance-sheet stress: GPU-backed debt, lease obligations, project finance, customer concentration, depreciation schedules, and whether contracted MW becomes billable MW on time.
CRWV should be retained as the high-attention reference benchmark for public neocloud economics, not as an underfollowed discovery candidate.
IREN is a large-cap but unusually pure AI-cloud transition candidate; later layers must stress-test NVIDIA/Microsoft contract economics, capex, GPU financing, and utilization.
APLD is a second-order AI capacity landlord candidate; later layers should verify CoreWeave lease commencement, project financing, power availability, and tenant concentration.
CIFR fits the preferred under-USD-10B underfollowed lane; its key survival tests are Fluidstack counterparty quality, 168MW delivery by September 2026, capex funding, and power economics.
Need a follow-up pass on BTDR, HUT, WULF, CORZ/Core Scientific status, and other crypto-to-AI infrastructure conversions to avoid missing smaller power-capacity owners.
NBIS should be retained as the reference neocloud anchor for specialized AI cloud capacity, but not treated as underfollowed after major Microsoft, Meta, and NVIDIA disclosures.
IREN is a high-purity but now larger-cap AI cloud capacity candidate; key survival checks are power delivery, GPU financing, customer concentration, and AI cloud ARR conversion.
APLD maps to the adjacent powered-AI-data-center capacity chokepoint rather than GPU cloud ownership; CoreWeave lease execution and financing/dilution are the main evidence gates.

CIFR is a speculative-shadow candidate because its AI relevance is hidden inside a bitcoin-mining-to-HPC transition and depends on converting power pipeline into contracted, financed AI hosting projects.

For this node, the strongest evidence ladder is: signed multi-year customer contract with credit support, secured power/interconnection, GPU supply or tenant equipment path, project financing, deployment milestones, utilization, then margin after depreciation and financing.
Need a later Layer 2 pass on lease liabilities, debt covenants, GPU depreciation, SLA penalties, and customer concentration across NBIS, IREN, APLD, and CIFR before any prioritization survives.
